# Lead Year 10

Head-of-year pastoral work for Year 10: about 210 pupils in eight tutor groups (10A to 10H). The role stays with Year 10, so each September I take on a new cohort while the previous one moves up to a new head of year. No end date: there is always a Year 10.

## Scope

- Attendance, behaviour follow-up, the tutor team, assemblies, wellbeing referrals and parent communication for the current Year 10.
- Belongs elsewhere: teaching my own classes ([[teach-history-classes]]), the residential ([[lead-school-trips]]), and the Middle Leadership Programme write-up of the attendance work ([[middle-leadership-programme]]).
- Safeguarding concerns go into [[lanternlog]] and to the DSL, [[fiona-mcrae]]. Nothing about a concern, a disclosure or a plan is written here. Pupil-level data stays in [[ledgerwise]]; this vault holds counts and percentages only.

## Current State

- Year 10 2026-27: 212 pupils, eight tutor groups, settled in after the [[year-10-transition-2026]] project closed on 2 October. First half-term attendance 94.3%, with 20 pupils [[persistent-absence|persistently absent]].
- The [[year-10-attendance-drive]] for the 2025-26 cohort ended at 93.2% against a 94% target. The weekly huddle with [[donna-whitlock]] and [[marek-nowicki]] carried on into this year without a gap.
- The [[year-10-newsletter]] is on its seventh issue (16 October 2026).
- Line manager for the pastoral side: [[adeel-chaudhry]], deputy head for behaviour and attendance.

## Active Projects and Workflows

- [[year-10-newsletter]], half-termly to families through Ledgerwise.
- [[run-the-weekly-attendance-huddle]] every Tuesday at 08:10.
- [[send-the-year-10-newsletter]] for the newsletter routine.
- Completed and worth reading before repeating: [[year-10-attendance-drive]], [[year-10-transition-2026]], [[parents-evening-review]].
- Tutor team roles: [[year-10-tutor-team-2026-27]]; assemblies: [[year-10-assembly-plan-2026-27]]; behaviour figures: [[year-10-behaviour-points-summary-2025-26]].

## Working Rhythm

My week as head of year is in [[head-of-year-weekly-rhythm]]. The fixed points: Monday briefing with tutors, Tuesday huddle, Thursday assembly (fortnightly), Friday behaviour points review. Parents' evening for Year 10 is in late November, in the format chosen by the [[parents-evening-review]].

## Next Actions

- [ ] Set the November parents' evening slots (video by default, in-person block 17:00 to 18:30) before half-term ends.
- [ ] Bring the 20 persistently absent pupils into the huddle caseload by name in Ledgerwise, not here.
- [ ] Agree spring assembly themes with the tutor team at the 2 November briefing.
- [ ] Hand the attendance figures for 2025-26 to the [[mlp-attendance-project-write-up]] in their final form.

## Maintenance Log

- 2026-10-02: Transition project closed; settling-in survey analysed.
- 2026-07-17: Attendance drive closed at 93.2%, 19 persistently absent.
- 2026-03-20: Parents' evening format decided.
- 2025-09-08: Took over as head of Year 10.
